utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa — I’m tracking repair drive logistics right now, but I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off table and tool station locations from Faye.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — once Faye sends those locations, I’ll fold them into the repair drive plan and let folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Rosa — I’ll keep tracking the setup details and pass along the exact locations once Faye confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Quinn, I’m still piecing things together from what folks have told me, but it sounds like porch lights and loose handrails are rising to the top. Have you heard of anyone who might need help getting items over to the drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I haven’t heard any names yet, but I’ll ask around and see who needs a hand getting items over. If anyone does, I’ll pass the word along right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. If you hear of anyone needing a hand, just let me know and I’ll help pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Rey, I’m tracking supplies for the repair drive—do you have any spare screws, duct tape, batteries, or a flashlight you could bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check what I have and bring whatever’s useful—do you want me to prioritize screws, tape, batteries, or the flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey—please prioritize batteries first, then screws if you have them. Oren may already be bringing duct tape and a flashlight, but extras wouldn’t hurt.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I was thinking of starting around 3:30, after the school pickup rush, and I can bring duct tape, a flashlight, and maybe some spare screws if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — 3:30 sounds sensible after pickup, and those supplies could help. Before we count on them, can you confirm the date and location, and whether we’re limiting repairs to small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh goodness, Hana, I’m pretty sure it’s at the community room, but I’d better double-check the date before I say it wrong; and yes, I had small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah — I’m coordinating around school pickup, and it looks like the repair drive will start around 3:30. Are you able to help then?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think so — I’m a bit scattered, but I should be able to help around 3:30. What do you want me to do?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help set up the drop-off table when you arrive and then direct parents to the right spot? If you can, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Uli, we’re lining up tools and small parts for Saturday—if you’ve got any spare screws, hinges, or a work lamp, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might have a small box of screws and maybe a lamp, Gus. I’ll check quietly tonight and let you know what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — that would be a big help. Just let me know what you find, and I’ll add it to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s going steady so far — I’m still keeping an eye out for anyone who needs help while I’m out. If you hear of anyone, send their name my way and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do—do you already have a list of who still needs help, or should I keep gathering names?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still pulling the list together, so keep gathering names for now—just send me who needs what, and I’ll pass it along to Eli.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — once you have the schedule, send it my way and I’ll help spread the word after my morning walk.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Eli — once the time and place are set, I’ll send you the schedule so you can pass it along on your walk.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. I’ll hold off until I have the firm details, then I’ll share them around after my walk.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What would you like me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam — could you help me pin down the schedule first? Once we’ve got the time sorted, I can get Eli and the others spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — let’s lock down a time that works for everyone, and I can help you spread the word once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’ll check with the building office about the community room, but let’s hold off on dates or money until we have the repair list, treasurer confirmation, and a basic tool inventory in writing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Pia—that sounds right. Can you also make sure the office confirms in writing who’s authorized to collect any money before we announce anything?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I’ll ask them for written confirmation on the room and who, if anyone, is authorized to collect funds, and we won’t announce anything until that’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive shaping up, and where could you use an extra pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries. Please start sorting tools from small appliances; Sam’s on electronics, and Bo’s spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll start sorting the small appliance tools now and check in if I spot anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bo, I’ve got Noah down for sorting the donated tools, so could you help with table setup or greeting folks when they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m pretty slammed, but I can probably swing by to help with greeting folks or a bit of table setup. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Bo — if you can be at the community hall around 9, I’ll put you on greeting folks first, and if there’s time we’ll have you help with tables.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m keeping it organized, Dane — I just need a clear list of anyone who needs help. Send them my way, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and send anyone who needs help your way. I can also check on Marco and see who else needs a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane — that’d help a lot. Just send me the names as you hear them, and I’ll keep the list organized.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Bo, I’m still checking the setup details with the school office, but the 3:30 start should avoid pickup traffic. I’ll share the drop-off table and tool station locations as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, 3:30 sounds good—send me the drop-off and tool station spots when you have them. I’ll keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check with the school office and send you the drop-off table and tool station locations as soon as I get them. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly I need you to spread the word and send any handy folks. If you can swing by for a bit too, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo — I’ll spread the word and send anyone handy your way, and I’ll swing by Saturday morning with my socket set and cordless drill.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. Saturday morning works—bring the tools and I’ll put you on loose chairs and small appliance fixes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m all set to bring my drill and hammer, and I’m also handling the electronics sorting—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s perfect. Please start with the porch lights and loose handrails as our safety priorities, and set aside any electronics that need special parts so I can track them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll start with the porch lights and loose handrails, and I’ll set aside any electronics that need special parts for you to track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we spread the word, can you confirm the date, location, and what repairs we’re accepting? I want to make sure we’ve got the details right first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t want to give you half-wrong details, Hana. Let me check with Rosa on the date and place, and I’ll bring you the repair list once I’ve finished asking around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — please check with Rosa first, and hold off on sharing anything until we confirm the date, place, and full repair list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, I’ve got you on the invite list, and I’ll send the time, location, and supply notes the moment they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and get ready to help gather what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo — once the notes come through, I’ll flag the most-needed items so you’ll know exactly where your help will count.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, can you check with the building office today about the community room, and I’ll start a basic tool-owner list so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I can check with the building office today and ask about available dates, any fees, and whether repairs are allowed in the room. I’ll report back before we commit to anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia—please ask if they have tables and outlets too, and tell me what times they’d actually let us use the room.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m checking in while I’m out — have you heard of anyone who needs repair help, or any small parts folks can spare for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, before I point anyone your way, can you confirm exactly what repairs are planned and who’s officially collecting any money or parts?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I only know we’re gathering tools and small parts this week and setting up tables Saturday morning; I haven’t heard of anyone officially collecting money, so I’ll check with Eli before telling folks anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hi Jules — I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive and reminding everyone to bring whatever tools or broken items they can. Once the time and place are firm, I’ll keep passing that along too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — that’s perfect. I’m just waiting on Hana to confirm the date and location, so for now let folks know we’re focusing on small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Jules — I’ll tell folks we’re focusing on small appliances, bikes, clothing, and simple electronics for now, and I’ll wait for Hana’s confirmed date and location before sharing those details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, Tess—the repair drive. I’m planning to start around 3:30, and I’m supposed to bring duct tape, maybe a flashlight, and some spare screws if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s just the sort of detail I needed, Oren — I’ll tell folks it’s starting around 3:30, and I’ll let Eli know after his walk so he can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess—that helps a lot. If I wander in without the screws, remind me I promised to check the junk drawer.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rey — for the repair drive, Noah’s taking on sorting the donated tools, so I’m checking whether you can help with table setup or greeting folks when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara — I can help with greeting folks, and I’ll keep asking around for the full volunteer and supply list so I don’t mix anything up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you — I’ll put you down for greeting folks, and I’ll keep Noah on tool sorting so we don’t double-book anyone.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—tell me what you’re bringing, and I’ll keep it on my list. I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off table and tool station spots.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can bring a small box of extra bulbs and some extension cords, though I’ll confirm after checking my closet. And if I hear who needs help carrying things over, I’ll pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — I’ll mark the bulbs and extension cords as tentative until you confirm. And yes, please pass along any carry-help requests so I can note who needs support and where.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
